title: FrameTrail tag definitions
description: Tag definitions: _data/tagdefinitions.json. Keys are tag ids, values the tag's label and description. Items refer to tags by id in frametrail:tags, and annotation thumbnails carry the ids as class names, so an id never changes once items use it.

oneOf.description: A tag: one label and an optional description.

label.description: The tag's name, as editors see it in the tag pickers and in Manage Tags.

description.description: What the tag is for. Shown in Manage Tags.

oneOf.description: Legacy. A tag with a label and description per language code, written before tags had one label. Read with the label in the interface language, else English, else the first; replaced by the one-label form the first time the tag is edited.

label.description: Label of the tag in this language.

description.description: Description of the tag in this language.
